snippet.title: Esoteric Ebb - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Join developer Christoffer Bodegård for a deep dive into Esoteric Ebb in this latest trailer for the upcoming single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. In Esoteric Ebb, unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign. Esoteric Ebb will be available on PC.
